info.name: School_ERP - Auth Service (Module 01)
info.description:
Postman collection for the Module 01 authentication and access-control controllers. Contains positive requests and applicable negative validation, unauthenticated, forbidden, and not-found scenarios. Set up a running service and seed tenant/user/branch data before running database-dependent requests. Authenticated requests require valid JWTs with the named roles. Includes current AuthController password lifecycle endpoints and path aliases. Run Register -> Login -> Profile -> Change Password -> Forgot Password -> Reset Password; configure role JWTs and targetUserId for admin actions. Sample tenant, branch, users, roles, permissions, MFA/session settings, API scopes, audit IP, and backup target are aligned with story/module1/module1.sql seed data. Seeded account password: Password@123. Auth registration examples use unique DPS-style values to avoid conflicts with seeded society/user records. Collection examples use the seed records from story/module1/module1.sql: DPS-SOC-01, DPS North Campus, admin_rajesh, principal_anita, teacher_vikram, and Password@123. Run the seeded role login requests to capture principalToken and teacherToken. Write operations use unused DPS-style identifiers to avoid colliding with seeded rows.

One folder per user story (US-00000, US-00001, US-00002, US-00003, US-00004, US-00005, US-00006, US-00007, US-00008, US-00009, US-00010, US-01001, US-01002, US-01003, US-01005). Run the folders in order: US-00000 registers and logs in and captures superAdminToken, principalToken and teacherToken, which the later folders use. US-01001 to US-01003 chain the password reset and change flow through authCurrentPassword.
